notes.title: AiliA Demo is now live!
notes.content:
Good evening, everyone! Although AiliA has been in development for a long time, this is our first time to connect with you all here. We’re thrilled to finally take this first step—introducing the two little girls who traverse mirror worlds to our players. We sincerely hope you’ll love our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42952284/2eb076b95a5fca2967beb217d06da423ec6d7f85.png[/img]

While your current demo is limited to Chapter 1, we’re excited to reveal that the full game features seven distinct worlds, over a hundred levels, and also hidden mirror shards for you to collect. Each world offers unique gameplay mechanics and immersive environments, which will meet you soon!

We hope you enjoy the game! Should you encounter any issues, please reach out to us via the following channels:

X:https://twitter.com/AiliAGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/7WZkDSGu
